production_requires: Actual source URLs/titles and a directly relevant instructional observation, not query text or project context.
Every declared supported subskill must be backed by this resource; compound units need each component, and missing qualifications remain unknown.
Source level must suit stated technology experience; advanced Python/statistics does not imply prior pandas/Matplotlib expertise.
Known access restriction is distinct from unavailable/removed; no playback verification required.
Page language is not assumed to be audio language; explain observed language scope and uncertainty.
No full project production verdict from software test counts, generic platform courses, or collection coverage without direct sources.

web_pomodoro_beginner: Timestamp-based accurate timer must not be inferred from setInterval alone.
Reset should restore timer/state; generic click event alone does not prove restoration.
Keyboard operation and visible focus/accessibility need explicit source evidence.
bicycle_csv_advanced: Known Python/statistics but first pandas and unfamiliar Matplotlib: a focused beginner-library tutorial can be useful.
read_csv does not prove row-count audit or reporting invalid rows separately.
Timestamp parsing must not assume chronological validity; duration policy needs actual stated requirements.
Generic groupby/count/bar drawing may support the operation only, not departure-hour bucketing, station-specific Top10, or output-label requirements without evidence.
arduino_reaction_beginner: Debouncing does not alone prove edge-triggered one activation during a long hold.
INPUT_PULLUP is active-low; do not import a different wiring assumption from a source.
Nonblocking millis timing and random waiting are independent claims.
State-machine lesson must actually address the relevant event/state control; generic LED blink does not prove game logic.
pygame_maze_intermediate: Grid-to-screen coordinate movement and wall/out-of-bounds checks require their own evidence.
Frame counting cannot prove real elapsed time.
ready/playing/won lifecycle and reset behavior must retain their state qualifiers.
QUIT event teaching does not automatically prove frame-rate limiting, or reset key semantics.
